notes.title: Save The Astronaut Update and Demo Release!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=hPFUpCUADcE;full][/previewyoutube]

Save The Astronaut has been online for nearly a month, and the support has been amazing, but we still need your help! 

With this update we are pleased to announce that Save The Astronaut has a demo! Not just a short demo either. We're giving you a 1/3 of the games content, just like classic games of the 90s would give you a large sum of content to try before you buy. 

We sincerely hope this will encourage you amazing people out there to support us. The game is on Steam for $1.99 and any sales of the game are going to keeping our lights on and creating more entertaining content with our own personal touch.

Once again, thank you everybody. We hope you'll check out the Save The Astronaut Demo and leave us some feedback and then go ahead and pick up a copy of the full release. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1404070/Save_The_Astronaut/

Further, to coincide with the release of the demo is a patch for the game, which adjusts the players movement and improves the feel of the gameplay. We've changed the way game overs are handled to avoid frustrating and tedious restarts. This was a community feedback decision, so please, never stop giving us feedback as we will always try to improve our games. That is a promise. 

You can also follow Open Maw Productions on Social media.[url=https://twitter.com/OpenMawTwitting]Twitter[/url][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC_DUu1QDPTIXutdt5_4sYKQ]Youtube[/url] [url=https://www.facebook.com/openmawproduction]facebook[/url]

Happy gaming!

Caitlin and Steven,
Open Maw Productions
